scenario: [LCRS.6.2.4]: an answer whose `corr` is the empty string retracts nothing. The host asserts two replies of one response schema with corr `""` (v 1, v 2), then a `CallError` with corr `""`; all three stay live, and the three probe rules log ["reply 1", "reply 2", "error"] in their source order. PATH PINNED: the host-assert supersede alone -- `ds_dispatch_supersede_arrival` from `engine_assert_body` (libds) and `ds.exec.lcrs_6_2_4_arrival_victims` from `ds.engine.host_assert_unstamped` (Mercury). No rule calls, so the call-side sweep ([LCRS.6.2.1]) is not reached. The break is an arrival supersede that treats `""` as a correlation: reply 2 retracts reply 1, the CallError retracts reply 2, and the probes log ["error"].
rules_ds:
schema Reply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    v: Int

service svc.read:
    kwarg n: Int
    response Reply

schema Probe scope explicit:
    k: Int

rule seen_one:
    Probe
    Reply x where x.v == 1
->
    log info "reply 1"

rule seen_two:
    Probe
    Reply x where x.v == 2
->
    log info "reply 2"

rule seen_error:
    Probe
    CallError
->
    log info "error"
